automation_consent_pending.description: Empty body. Returns all unexpired broker requests with remaining timeout budgets.

id.description: Broker request id from the consent-request frame.

persist.description: Remember the allow/deny for this session's matching tuple.

prompt.description: Deprecated prompt echo accepted for compatibility and ignored by the broker.

twinId.description: Twin id to bind, or null to unbind.

id.description: Omit to create; provide to update.

request_id.description: ID of the pending approval request emitted via WS.

decision.description:
`allow` proceeds once; `allow_always` proceeds and persists a standing
permission for this tool/rule for the session; `deny` rejects with the
optional `message` shown to the model. To edit-and-allow, send
`decision: allow` together with `updated_input` (the substituted tool
arguments) — there is no separate `edit` decision value.

message.description: Optional rejection reason or note (denial only).

updated_input.description: Replacement tool input — substituted for the original arguments when sent (typically with `decision: allow`).

remote_execution_context.description:
Remote-execution provenance minted by the host when the turn was dispatched.
Required on every companion-originated control message: the arm validates and
consumes it (remote_execution::validate_and_consume) before acting.

session_id.description: Logical session id chosen by the caller (Dexie row key).

prompt.description:
Either a plain string or an array of content blocks (text + image) — forwarded
verbatim to the Claude Agent SDK. Image blocks follow Anthropic's content-block format.

options.description:
Per-call options forwarded verbatim to the Claude Agent SDK (or the
AI SDK dispatch path for non-Anthropic providers). Unrecognised
fields ride along under `extra` (serde flatten). `null` is rejected
for optional fields — use `undefined`/missing instead, otherwise the
SDK's option parser crashes with "Cannot read properties of null".

systemPrompt.description: Replaces the SDK default system prompt. Mutually exclusive with appendSystemPrompt.

appendSystemPrompt.description: Appended to the SDK default. Mutually exclusive with systemPrompt.

mcpServers.description: Per-name MCP server config map; forwarded to the SDK verbatim.

agents.description: Dynamic subagent definitions keyed by name.

strictMcpConfig.description: When true, only `mcpServers` from this object are loaded — settings.json is ignored.

resumeSessionId.description: Resume an existing SDK session by id. Mutually exclusive with forkFromSessionId.

forkFromSessionId.description: Fork a new branch from an existing SDK session id.

provider.description:
Provider id this turn dispatches against. `null`/missing or
`"anthropic"` keeps the Claude Agent SDK path; any other value
(`openai`, `google`, `mistral`, `cohere`, `openrouter`, custom)
flows through the AI SDK dispatcher.

protocol.description: AI SDK protocol family (required for custom provider ids).

aliasResolution.description: Renderer-side metadata; the sidecar ignores this.

key.description: API key string, or null to clear.

command_id.description: Correlation id echoed on the sidecar ack, so the caller can match the response to this request.

token.description: OAuth bearer string, or null to clear.

custom_headers.description: Ordered `[name, value]` pairs forwarded as ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADER_* at sidecar spawn. Omit to leave the existing set untouched; send [] to clear it.

remote_execution_context.description:
Remote-execution provenance minted by the host when the turn was dispatched.
Required on every companion-originated control message: the arm validates and
consumes it (remote_execution::validate_and_consume) before acting.

id.description: JSON-RPC request id — string or number.

segments.description: Edited segments replacing the draft's own (ADR-0131 — the phone's draft editor sends what the operator actually approved).

connector_enqueue_outbound.description: Relay a human-authored reply into a platform conversation (ADR-0131). The host replays idempotently on `request.metadata.idempotencyKey`.

clientMessageId.description: Client-minted id for the local `messages` row; the host reuses it so the optimistic mirror and the authoritative row converge.

nonce.description: Deterministic dedupe nonce (≤25 chars); Discord returns the already-created message on a retry.

conversation_overrides_update.description: Legacy `{ input }` upsert, or an ADR-0131 `{ mutation }` envelope the host applies with full audit + assignment-trail semantics.

capabilities.description: Capability ids from lib/platform/capabilities.ts (core ids or plugin:<id>).

query.description: Filter set. A bare flattened query object (no wrapper) is also accepted.

target.description: Hierarchy prefix match on the record target.

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the message.

sinceMs.description: Only entries at or after this Unix-epoch ms.

sidecarPath.description: Legacy local-Tauri hint; ignored by the headless Companion facade, which resolves the packaged host sidecar.
Legacy local-Tauri hint; ignored by the headless Companion facade, which resolves the packaged host sidecar.

deviceId.description: Overwritten by the authenticated RPC device identity.

manifestJson.description: Plugin manifest JSON. Must parse, declare an `id` equal to `pluginId`, and a non-empty `version`.

deviceId.description: This device's id, so the host can refcount watchers.

content.description: UTF-8 or base64-encoded; encoding given in `encoding`.

clean.description: When true, blow away pre-existing files in the directory before writing.

dir_name.description: Kebab-case skill slug (the directory name under ~/.claude/skills/).

table.description:
Allowlist; mirror of `lib/sync/types.ts:SyncableTable` (live
registry: `sync_registry.rs::default_tables`, listable via
`sync_list_tables`). Any other value returns 400 to prevent a
malicious phone from asking for arbitrary tables.
`agentTeamBoard` (v104) is the one-way Agent-Team board mirror —
board edits travel back as `team_*` control RPCs, never as sync
writes.

since.description: Last cursor the phone received (ms epoch). Pass `0` for a full pull.

allowIrreversible.description: Explicit one-shot override when inverse data cannot fit in the local ledger.

sourceIds.description:
Optional. Scope the ingest to these twin source ids. Omit
(or send an empty array) to ingest every source attached to
the twin.

value.description: Canonical JSON tree to serialise into the agent's format.
